solver_notes: Native deterministic aarch64 regression independently executed on the RAK Miner v2. The legacy pointer-only CAS lane reproduces ABA under a forced preemption: a suspended consumer holds A and stale next=B while another consumer pops A and B then recycles A above C; stale CAS succeeds and corrupts the head to B. The fixed head is an aligned 16-byte {pointer,uint64_epoch} tuple loaded and compared with acquire/release LDAXP/STLXP pair CAS. Every successful update increments the full 64-bit epoch, so the same recycled address cannot satisfy the stale pair. The fixed suspended CAS observes epoch 3 instead of 0, rejects the update, preserves A->C, then retries to C at epoch 4. Stress rejected 100000/100000 stale ABA attempts. Disassembly contains LDAXP/STLXP; no mutex or libatomic fallback. Scope: standalone native reproduction/fix for the stated lockless_queue.c invariant, not a claimed patch to upstream CPython. Tagged generations prevent ABA but do not by themselves provide safe node memory reclamation.
